intro: The Parvati Valley's riverside backpacker base. That is Kasol in one line — but there is a lot more to it. This guide covers when to go, where to stay and what not to miss.

sections.heading: Why visit Kasol
paragraphs: Kasol (Himachal Pradesh) is known for its mountain, backpacking and trek experiences. Overall it is budget-friendly — hostels, homestays and local food keep costs low.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is March to June and September to November.

sections.heading: How to get there
paragraphs: Overnight bus from Delhi to Bhuntar, then a local bus or taxi.

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: Carry cash — ATMs in the valley often run dry.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Kasol?
faq.a: March to June and September to November.
Overnight bus from Delhi to Bhuntar, then a local bus or taxi.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Kasol?
faq.a: Popular choices: Kasol for cafés; Chalal for quiet riverside stays; Tosh for views.
